parole.significato: a female storyteller or narrator of fairy tales
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian Шехераза́да (Šexerazáda), from Persian شهرازاد (šahrâzâd), alternative form of شهرزاد (šahrzâd, literally “child of the city”), from شهر (šahr, “city”) + ـزاد (-zâd, “child of”). The noun is a reference to the fictional character.
